title: Machine selection
description: Projects share universe Test Machines and compete for each host's one serial lease. The QA requirement token test-machine:NAME selects a registered resource. Single-host admission derives OS only from method_config.os/platform, executable steps, capability requirements or declared machines’ registered os before ranking verified hosts. Instructions never choose an OS. An undeclared platform refuses with test_machine_platform_undeclared and asks for method_config.os or method_config.test_machine. Simultaneous cases retain the declared driver, admit each registered host and require the declared platform somewhere in the full set. A missing platform refuses with registration and verification recovery.
